title.narrative: GEF GOLD: Contribution Towards the Elimination of Mercury and Improvement of the Gold Value Chain in the Artisanal and Small-Scale Gold Mining Sector

description.narrative: Expand the elimination of mercury in ASGM operations, facilitate access to finance, and improve the gold supply chain to provide miners in Burkina Faso more direct access to the international market
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The long-term planned impact of the project is to transform the ASGM sector in Burkina Faso from an informal/illegal activity to a fully formalized source of livelihood for a significant part of the population. Gold as a commodity has a very high value and the potential to change the socioeconomic conditions of the artisanal miners. At the local level and by introducing an integrated gold supply chain approach in Burkina Faso, the project will offer higher gold prices to the miners, hence directly providing them with economic benefits. In addition, the revolving fund will enhance miner’s accessibility to mercury free processing plants which can contribute to overall reduction of mercury in the sector. The promotion of social enterprises for mining community and gender mainstreaming will positively contribute to socio benefits. At the national level, the development of a sound ASGM legal framework will generate an increase of formal artisanal gold production, reducing thus the illegal export of gold out of the country. This will mean additional resources for the government that can then be allocated for the development at the country at large.
